title: Rooming-List Uplift to the Commitment Share (Group Room Blocks)
content:
The commitment share of a Group Room Blocks increase is raised by a rooming-list uplift that follows how much of the contract the rooming list already names, counted as the room nights of the organiser's confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block against the contracted room nights before the increase:

| Room nights of those reservations, as a share of the contracted room nights before the increase | Uplift |
|---|---|
| at least 90 percent | 25 percentage points |
| at least 75 percent but below 90 percent | 10 percentage points |
| below 75 percent | no uplift |

The commitment share as raised by the uplift and lowered by any cut is kept between zero and one hundred percent; the bound applies once, to the share as it stands after the uplift and every cut.

**Records read.** The organiser's Room Reservations that name the block, are booked at the Group Block Rate and stand confirmed, with the nights each carries; and the block's contracted room nights as they stand before the increase is implemented.

### Worked shares (hypothetical block contracted for 200 room nights before the increase)

| Nights of confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block | Share | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 180 | 90 percent | 25 points |
| 179 | 89.5 percent | 10 points |
| 150 | 75 percent | 10 points |
| 149 | 74.5 percent | none |

Reservations naming the block that are cancelled, or booked on a rate plan other than the Group Block Rate, add no nights to the share.

**Bound (hypothetical shares).** A share of 100 percent raised by 25 points and lowered by 20 points by a cut stands at 105 percent and is kept at 100 percent; a share of 75 percent raised by 25 points with no cut stands at 100 percent.
